hero.intro: Professional consultancy and compliance support for Malaysian food businesses preparing for halal certification.
hero.artLabel: Abstract illustration of a growing plant

about.title: Halal compliance made clearer, more practical, and more accessible.
about.body: AHC Resources helps restaurants, cafes, bakeries, caterers and food manufacturers prepare for Malaysia Halal Certification through practical systems, documentation and audit readiness.

disclaimer.title: Independent guidance. Clear boundaries.
disclaimer.body: AHC Resources is an independent private halal consultancy. We assist with compliance preparation, documentation, training, gap assessments and application support. We do not issue or approve Malaysia Halal Certificates, and we do not guarantee certification approval.

services.title: Support for every step of your halal journey.
services.intro: Tailored support around the reality of your premises, products and people.

consultancy.title: Halal consultancy
consultancy.body: Certification preparation, halal requirements assessment, ingredient and supplier verification, documentation review, halal management systems, application preparation and audit support.

gap.title: Halal gap assessment
gap.body: A structured review of ingredients, suppliers, production areas, storage, equipment, cleaning, documentation, staff practices and halal management controls. Receive a report identifying strengths, improvements and risk areas.

documentation.title: Documentation assistance
documentation.body: Practical help organising ingredient and supplier lists, certificates, specifications, process flows, SOPs, cleaning and purchasing procedures, traceability, audits and training records.

verification.title: Ingredient & supplier verification
verification.body: Know what is inside your ingredients. We review raw materials, additives, flavourings, meat, dairy, sauces, seasonings, imported ingredients and relevant packaging records.

audit.title: Mock halal audit & training
audit.body: Test your readiness before assessment with a review of documentation, premises, ingredients, processes and staff. We also provide halal awareness and operational training within our qualified scope.

consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.body: We understand your business, products, ingredients and current practices.

gap.title: Gap assessment
gap.body: We identify gaps against applicable halal requirements.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.body: We organise the necessary procedures and records.

implementation.title: Implementation
implementation.body: We support your team to put effective controls in place.

audit.title: Mock audit
audit.body: We assess readiness and advise on corrective action.

application.title: Application support
application.body: We help prepare the application and supporting documents.

industries.title: Built for the way food businesses actually work.

packages.title: Choose the support that fits your starting point.

readiness.title: Halal readiness assessment
readiness.body: For businesses that want to understand their current position.

certificates.question: Does AHC Resources issue halal certificates?
certificates.answer: No. We are an independent private consultancy. Certificates are issued by the relevant halal certification authority.

guarantee.question: Can you guarantee my halal certificate?
guarantee.answer: No. We help businesses prepare and improve compliance before applying, but the final assessment and approval remain with the relevant authority.

myehalal.question: Can you help with MYeHALAL?
myehalal.answer: We can provide preparation and application assistance within the scope permitted for a private consultant.

smallRestaurants.question: Do you work with small restaurants?
smallRestaurants.answer: Yes. Our support can be tailored to the scale and complexity of your business.

contact.body: Tell us about your business, halal status and what you are working towards. We will help identify the next right step.
